Ice Damage

Version

8.10
December 11, 2007
Christmas Update 2007

Status

Active
See also: Freezing
This is a type of Magical Damage as well as a Tibia Element. It appears on the Game Window as Sea Blue Text.

Ice Attacks

Spells and Runes

List of spells and runes which inflict Ice Damage.

Spells

Name Words Prem Level Vocations Mana Group Effect
Chill Out exevo infir frigo hur ✗ 1 Druids 8 Attack Shoots a weak area attack directly in front of the caster, dealing ice damage.
Ice Strike exori frigo ✗ 8 Sorcerers and Druids 20 Attack Shoots an ice missile at the selected target up to 3 square meters away. If no target is selected, the damage is focused on the single square right in front of the caster.
Ice Wave exevo frigo hur ✗ 18 Druids 25 Attack Shoots an area attack directly in front of the caster, dealing ice damage.
Strong Ice Wave exevo gran frigo hur ✓ 40 Druid 170 Attack Shoots a powerful, but short ranged area attack directly in front of the caster, dealing strong ice damage.
Eternal Winter exevo gran mas frigo ✓ 60 Druids 1050 Attack Summons a raging blizzard, dealing extremely high ice damage on a total of 64 squares around the caster. The spell deals about 5-10% more damage than Wrath of Nature, but its area of effect is smaller.
Strong Ice Strike exori gran frigo ✓ 80 Druid 60 Attack Shoots a powerful ice missile at the selected target up to 7 square meters away. If no target is selected, the damage is focused on the single square right in front of the caster.
Ultimate Ice Strike exori max frigo ✓ 100 Druid 100 Attack Shoots a very powerful ice missile at the selected target up to 7 square meters away. If no target is selected, the damage is focused on the single square right in front of the caster.
Ice Burst exevo ulus frigo ✓ 300 Druids 230 Attack Casts a powerful ring of ice around the character.

Note: With exception of the basic Ice Strike available for both Druids and Sorcerers, Instant Ice Attack spells are a specialty of Druids. Also, it is the only type of damage that does not have a player-inflicted damage over time variant.
